sourceSentences: Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as bonus true damage.
Lillia can move during Blooming Blows' cast time.
Lillia can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.
Lillia can hop over the edges of certain walls despite the ability being unable to traverse terrain.
The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground
The spot at which the seed will collide with terrain is highlighted while it is rolling.
Swirlseed's origin is determined from Lillia's position at the start of cast, the rolling direction is determined from Lillia's position at the end of cast
Spell shield will not prevent falling asleep nor block the wake-up damage. The lullaby's drowsy application will be blocked.
Lilting Lullaby's application does not trigger aggro from turrets, only its triggering damage does.
Dream-Laden Bough persistent damage will still cause Lillia to trigger turret aggro, unless she casts Lilting Lullaby right before it runs out.
Dream Dust is applied even if the target takes no damage from an ability, e.g. by being shielded or invulnerable, but not when the ability hit is prevented in the first place (e.g. spell shield).
